body: Jacob Misiorowski threw the fastest World Series pitch in the tracking era, topping Aroldis Chapman’s 103.2 mph in 2016.
headline: 103.5 mph.
methodology: MLB official Game 849805 records Jacob Misiorowski’s first pitch to Yandy Díaz at 103.5 mph. MLB’s report identifies Chapman’s prior World Series record as 103.2 mph in 2016 and dates the tracking era to 2008. This is a World Series tracking-era record, not an all-postseason or all-time claim.
